C-GLOBAL-SETTINGS-L10N.Summary: Introduce a GT7-style GT menu and settings section, with one persisted application language that controls all owned UI and available localized feature content.
C-GLOBAL-SETTINGS-L10N.Problem: The GT button currently goes directly Home, and Apex and Brand Central expose independent language controls while most application UI is hard-coded English. The router is created inside build, which would reset navigation during an application locale rebuild.

Goals.Goal: Open an accessible GT menu from the existing grey GT logo on desktop and mobile, with working Home and Settings destinations.
Provide an independent responsive settings screen inspired by the official GT7 Options interface: dark surface, segmented category navigation, compact tiles and actual preference controls.
Use one central persisted language setting: System by default, Russian or English as explicit choices, English fallback for unsupported system locales.
Apply the selected locale immediately to all application-owned UI, date/number presentation, standard Flutter controls, Brand Central records and Apex content.
Remove per-feature language selectors, preserve navigation and unsaved input while switching locale, and retain existing audio preferences and playback behaviour.

Constraints.Constraint: Follow Provider/ChangeNotifier, central AppScope injection, auto_route and the FVM-pinned SDK.
Use standard flutter_localizations and generated typed ARB resources. Verify current generator options against the pinned SDK; do not copy the obsolete synthetic-package setting.
Keep AppRouter alive for the AppView lifetime. Locale changes must not construct a new router or reset the current route.
Translations cover app-owned text in screens, overlays, errors, telemetry and custom painters. Stable route names, serialized enums, protocol fields and vehicle IDs remain language-independent.
Source-provided names, model names, quotations and unavailable external translations retain their original form; never fabricate translated car histories.
Central language selection takes precedence over legacy Apex-only preferences, and source caches and pending requests must not leak the previous language into new content.
Only update intl and dependencies required for compatibility with the pinned Flutter localization SDK. Preserve unrelated package versions.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new controller, race, hardware or graphics settings that the companion does not implement.
No new ambient music library, telemetry protocol changes, renderer-crash repair, cloud deployment, commit or push.
No incomplete translation options: the first complete UI locales are Russian and English; additional complete locales can be added through the same ARB pipeline later.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The grey GT logo opens/closes a GT menu on desktop and mobile. Home and Settings work, menus dismiss safely, and keyboard/back interaction is supported.
Settings opens as an independent screen, closes back to the previous route and uses the GT7-style Global/Audio/About composition with functional controls.
Fresh install follows the system; explicit Russian/English choices persist across restart; selecting System resumes following system locale changes.
Switching locale updates the current screen, menus, tooltips, loading/error/empty messages, HUD/telemetry labels, date/number presentation and standard Flutter UI without navigation reset.
Brand Central history/specifications and Apex menu/articles follow the shared language. Their local language buttons are absent.
Audio controls use the existing MusicService and SoundService, preserving stored volumes, enabled flags, lifecycle pause and current-track behaviour.
Resource coverage checks detect missing RU/EN messages and placeholders, and the migration inventory is reconciled against text literals and painter strings.
RU/EN widget coverage includes widths 320 to 1920 and text scale 1.5; menu, settings, route continuity, persistence, language fallback and stale content have tests.
Verify the GT-menu-to-settings flow, live locale switching and source content on a running macOS app and iPhone Simulator, with rendered screenshots and runtime-error inspection.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: FVM gen-l10n, changed-file analysis and resource coverage
Dart MCP parser/state/widget/navigation tests and full regression suite
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Live desktop and iPhone GT menu, settings, RU/EN switching, preserved route and language-specific official content.

Assumptions.Assumption: Two fully translated UI languages are appropriate initially: Russian and English.
Settings includes Global, Audio and About categories; only companion-supported controls are shown.
The user reviews this concrete scope before the executable plan and source implementation.
